# prime-contextmenu

prime-rs: ContextMenu component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/contextmenu) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-contextmenu) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/contextmenu.md)

ContextMenu — a port of PrimeNG 21.1.10's `p-contextmenu`.

A menu with nested submenus that opens at the cursor on a right click (the `contextmenu` event) on a target, on the whole document
(`global`) or manually via `ContextMenuRef`; on touch devices by a long press (`press_delay`). Items are
`prime_menu::MenuItem`; the path, keyboard and search logic is shared with `TieredMenu` (the `prime-tieredmenu` crate).

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_contextmenu::{ContextMenu, ContextMenuRef};
use prime_menu::MenuItem;

let model = vec![MenuItem::new().label("Copy"), MenuItem::new().label("Rename")];
let html = Owner::new().with(|| {
    let menu = ContextMenuRef::new();
    menu.show_at(10.0, 20.0);
    view! { <ContextMenu model=model popup_ref=menu /> }.to_html()
});
assert!(html.contains("p-contextmenu-root-list") && html.contains("Rename"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-contextmenu = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["contextmenu"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
